description: Assembly quality canon for scene and episode assembly from component assets.

quality_dimensions.name: Asset Completeness
quality_dimensions.description: All required assets must be present and valid.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Every asset referenced in assembly plan exists and passes validation.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Missing assets, stub files, or validation failures in required components.

quality_dimensions.name: Codec Compliance
quality_dimensions.description: Output must use approved codecs and containers.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Video codec from approved list. Container matches delivery spec.

quality_dimensions.name: Resolution and Framerate
quality_dimensions.description: Output must match approved resolution and framerate.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Resolution and fps match delivery spec exactly.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Wrong resolution, fps, or aspect ratio.

quality_dimensions.name: Subtitle Integrity
quality_dimensions.description: Subtitles must be present, readable, and timed correctly.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Subtitles match script. Timing within +/- 200ms. Readable styling.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Missing subtitles, wrong text, or unreadable styling.
